name: mixed_quick_smoke
description: Small manual mixed-weapon sanity pass for Glock and MP5 launch, tagging, and report plumbing. It structures evidence collection but does not prove gameplay truth by itself.

steps.name: glock_smoke
steps.operatorNote: Take one recovered single shot, exercise hold-to-fire rejection, and attempt one dummy headshot.

steps.name: mp5_smoke
steps.operatorNote: Take one short burst, one longer burst, and one moving spray pass before the headshot attempt.
